english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for forcibly pulling a solid object out, such as a tooth, splinter, or stump.

examples.english: The dentist will extract my wisdom tooth tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 聽日牙醫會拔出我隻智慧齒。
